intended_object: This is the structured RAM command that runs one selected Turing-machine transition. It wraps the straight-line operation list `actionOps` with `Structured.Cmd.basics`. It belongs to the library's sparse simulation of TMs by RAMs (docstring and module docs).
explanation: The definition only wraps `actionOps tm state symbols` as a `Structured.Cmd`. It is one piece of a specific compilation of Turing-machine steps into RAM code, and it is used in `dispatchSymbols`. The literature has no standard object that it corresponds to. It is an internal device of the library's simulation proof, so it cannot be compared against a textbook definition, and Mathlib has nothing comparable.
